intro: Seeking Strahad is an Alliance warlock quest that sends practitioners of the dark arts from Stormwind City across the Great Sea to the Barrens. There, beneath the gaze of the goblin port of Ratchet, they seek the expertise of Strahad Farsan to learn the summoning of felhunters. It marks a warlock's passage into the higher, more dangerous tiers of demonic subjugation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is time you learned the felhunter summoning, friend. I do not have the reagents and items necessary to teach you here, so you will have to seek out another, Strahad Farsan, another of our inner circle.
He makes his residence in the goblin port of Ratchet. I will send word ahead of you to inform him of your coming.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend? Ah, of course. Our latest prodigy. The real thing can't live up to the legend, I'm afraid.
No matter, you've come here to learn, not to hear me make jokes to myself.
